title: Zesty Creamy Goan Fish Curry
description: A tangy, creamy Goan fish curry that blends lemon zest, coconut milk and a splash of fermented fish sauce for a bold, gluten‑free experience.

ingredients.name: Firm white fish fillets (tilapia or pomfret)
Lemon zest
ingredients.notes: Divided: ½ tsp for seasoning, ½ tsp for garnish

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, ginger, and broken red chilies; cook for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish sauce, ½ tsp of lemon zest, and the lemon juice; stir well and let the mixture simmer for 3 minutes.
Gently slide the fish pieces into the sauce; cover and cook for 5–7 minutes, or until the fish flakes easily.
Season with a pinch of salt if needed, and adjust the lemon zest or fish sauce to taste.
Transfer the curry to a serving dish; sprinkle the remaining lemon zest and garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve hot over steamed rice or gluten‑free flatbread.
